en: Black‑and‑white photograph of an outdoor public swimming pool complex in a rural or small‑town setting. In the foreground, people in 1950s–1960s style swimwear are bathing and playing in the rectangular pool. Along the pool edge runs a concrete deck with a series of white pergola-style columns and potted plants. Behind the pool are low modernist buildings, one with a circular or polygonal pavilion topped by a small dome or cupola. Further back are trees, fields, scattered houses with sloped roofs, and gentle hills, suggesting a countryside spa or recreation resort.
